workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation plan-only IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority has a pure validation command-result contract, proof artifact contract, proof-out adapter, and file-emission contract. It intentionally still blocks validate-plan-only, so callers cannot request non-writing proof-out plan facts through the command contract without a separate admission.

splitDecision.reason: Plan-only proof-out facts are the smallest remaining pure command-result behavior after the validation command contract. They are smaller and safer than runtime locator invocation, OS inspection, runtime validation execution, compare execution, LabVIEWCLI, Docker orchestration, terminal process wiring, package/bin publication, release, Marketplace, or source-copying work.
splitDecision.proofOutFileEmissionBoundary: plan-only composes proof artifact and proof-out adapter facts but must not call the already admitted file-emission writer

allowed: prerequisite references to the already implemented settings write, validation readback, validation runtime outcome, validation proof-artifact, proof-out adapter, proof-out file-emission, and validation command-contract slices
package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0
option term --proof-out <dir> as an already admitted proof-out target shape
proof-out target facts, artifact file facts, proof JSON facts, issue Markdown facts, non-interactive guidance, blocked reason, blocked side effects, and requirement IDs
decision that plan-only is a non-writing mode over existing adapter facts
corrected Docker wording that Docker provider selection means the latest supported NI LabVIEW image family, 64-bit-only by image/platform, with no user-facing Docker bitness choice
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
private proof packets or private issue templates
OS inspection, runtime locator invocation, private path discovery, or environment probing behavior
file writes for the plan-only mode
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof or live terminal proof
package/bin publication, launcher/profile mutation, VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation
